resumeHomeFaqQuestion1: Does it cost anything to build a resume?
resumeHomeFaqAnswer1: No. It is free and open source; PDF, long-image, and Markdown exports carry no watermark and no hidden fees.
resumeHomeFaqAnswer2: No. Your resume stays in this browser; only AI features send the needed content to the model provider you configured, and desensitize mode can hide your name, phone, and email.
resumeHomeFaqAnswer3: PDF, long image (PNG / PDF), Markdown, HTML, and JSON configuration backup, all free and watermark-free; PDF can be rendered by your browser or our server.
resumeHomeFaqQuestion4: Can I change the layout and content to my own style?
resumeHomeFaqAnswer4: Sections can be added, hidden, reordered, or created as custom sections; colors, fonts, text sizes, and spacing are adjustable with multiple layout templates; text supports rich formatting and hidden fields keep their data.
resumeHomeFaqQuestion5: Does it support Chinese and other languages?
resumeHomeFaqAnswer5: Yes. Previews offer headings in eight languages, the interface comes in Chinese and English, and AI translation covers a whole resume or selected sections.
